verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a managed data platform like Pinecone, which could offer scheduled backups, imports or workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only on-demand backups and index management via SDK, API, console and MCP, which are one-off actions rather than a recurring schedule. No scheduler, cron or recurring-workflow capability appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
